TRANSMUTER-SULFUR.title: Sulfur
TRANSMUTER-SULFUR.description: Reagent debuff. Deals damage equal to its stacks at the end of the enemy's turn. Combines with [gold]Mercury[/gold] ([gold]Detonate[/gold]) or [gold]Salt[/gold] ([gold]Calcify[/gold]).
TRANSMUTER-MERCURY.title: Mercury
TRANSMUTER-MERCURY.description: Reagent debuff. Enemy takes +1 Attack damage per stack. Combines with [gold]Sulfur[/gold] ([gold]Detonate[/gold]) or [gold]Salt[/gold] ([gold]Dissolve[/gold]).
TRANSMUTER-SALT.title: Salt
TRANSMUTER-SALT.description: Reagent debuff. Hitting this enemy with an Attack grants 1 [gold]Block[/gold] per stack. Combines with [gold]Sulfur[/gold] ([gold]Calcify[/gold]) or [gold]Mercury[/gold] ([gold]Dissolve[/gold]).
TRANSMUTER-STABILIZE.title: Stabilize
TRANSMUTER-STABILIZE.description: Pauses 2-Reagent [gold]Reactions[/gold] on an enemy until end of turn, allowing all 3 [gold]Reagents[/gold] to combine into [gold]Magnum Opus[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-DETONATE.title: Detonate
TRANSMUTER-DETONATE.description: [gold]Sulfur[/gold] + [gold]Mercury[/gold] Reaction (X = total stacks consumed): Deal [blue]3X[/blue] damage to the target and [blue]2X[/blue] damage to ALL other enemies.
TRANSMUTER-CALCIFY.title: Calcify
TRANSMUTER-CALCIFY.description: [gold]Salt[/gold] + [gold]Sulfur[/gold] Reaction (X = total stacks consumed): Gain [blue]2X[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and apply [blue]ceil(X/3)[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-DISSOLVE.title: Dissolve
TRANSMUTER-DISSOLVE.description: [gold]Salt[/gold] + [gold]Mercury[/gold] Reaction (X = total stacks consumed): Destroy the target's [gold]Block[/gold], apply [blue]ceil(X/2)[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], and draw [blue]1[/blue] card ([blue]2[/blue] if X >= 6).
TRANSMUTER-REAGENT.title: Reagent
TRANSMUTER-REAGENT.description: Alchemical debuffs applied to enemies: [gold]Salt[/gold], [gold]Sulfur[/gold], and [gold]Mercury[/gold]. When 2+ different Reagents are on an enemy, all stacks are consumed to trigger a [gold]Reaction[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-REACTION.title: Reaction
TRANSMUTER-REACTION.description:
Triggered when 2+ different [gold]Reagents[/gold] are on an enemy (X = total stacks consumed):
[gold]Detonate[/gold] (Sulfur + Mercury): [blue]3X[/blue] damage + [blue]2X[/blue] to others.
[gold]Calcify[/gold] (Salt + Sulfur): [blue]2X[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] + [blue]ceil(X/3)[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
[gold]Dissolve[/gold] (Salt + Mercury): Strip [gold]Block[/gold], [blue]ceil(X/2)[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] ([blue]2[/blue] if X >= 6).
TRANSMUTER-MAGNUM_OPUS.title: Magnum Opus
TRANSMUTER-MAGNUM_OPUS.description: [gold]Salt[/gold] + [gold]Sulfur[/gold] + [gold]Mercury[/gold] Reaction (X = total stacks consumed): Trigger [gold]Detonate[/gold], [gold]Calcify[/gold], and [gold]Dissolve[/gold] all at once at full potency X.
